t: The Biggest Cheating Scandal in Trackmania History

q.x: This trust system reminds me of social verification of records in Trackmania. Since physics is deterministic, suspicious replay input is the source of truth which is both easy to fabricate (e.g. via TAS tools) and verify (available in replay file).
